modules.module_title: Preparing raw materials, consumables and tools for rolling and drawing process

pcs.pc_description: determine the quantity and weight of required raw material like ingot, a bar etc., of precious metal or alloy
select appropriate consumables and tools like cutter, files, hammer, sandpaper etc.,
ensure the proper working condition of the tools, equipment and machines like a rolling mill, drawing plate, drawing bench etc., before starting the process

modules.module_title: Rolling a sheet and a thick wire from precious metal

pcs.pc_description: hammer, anneal, pickle, rinse the ingot before carrying out rolling on a rolling machine
check rollers for any debris or excess oil causing slippage and for parallel roller alignment
set appropriate width or gap between rollers of roller machine using handle before every pass to achieve the required sheet or wire thickness
ensure the sheet is fed straight to the rolls to avoid the formation of crescent-shaped edges
ensure textured material is fed properly along with sheet in case of textured roller printing
ensure the wire is fed in the square grooves and turned 90 degrees each time or pass to get the correct shape and prevent unwanted flange
check the thickness of sheet or wire using vernier calliper or gauges after every pass
anneal rolled sheet or wire at regular intervals to avoid cracking or flaking, uneven elongation causing swept or rockered sheet etc.,
inspect the rolled sheet for any uneven thickness due to crowning of rollers, roll marks, rolled in scale and kinks etc.,
inspect the rolled wire for any grooves, chatter marks etc.,
accumulate precious metal dust or fragments dispersed during the process as per standard operating procedure (SOP)
maintain a proper log for metal loss, preventive maintenance etc.,
carry out oiling, cleaning of the rollers and rolling machines or mills etc., at regular intervals as per schedule

modules.module_title: Drawing a thin wire from precious metal using draw bench

pcs.pc_description: anneal rolled thick wire of hexagonal or square cross-section
prepare the wire for drawing by filing one end to form a tapered shape
ensure the wire is properly lubricated to reduce excessive friction while drawing at the draw cone
pull or draw the wire fixed on drawing bench through the hole on draw plate of required different cross-section or shape using tongs
check thickness or diameter of the wire using wire gauges after every drawing pass
anneal wire at regular intervals or passes to avoid cracking or wrapping of wire
inspect the rolled wire for appropriate final shape and size or defects like the formation of fins, scales etc.,
accumulate precious metal dust or fragments dispersed during the process as per standard operating procedure (SOP)
carry out oiling, cleaning of the draw plates at regular intervals as per schedule
draw wire or roll sheets per day against the target given
ensure timely delivery of the wires and the sheets to enable the commencement of various component making processes
update the supervisor on the work completion status at the end of shift

modules.module_title: Preparing raw materials, consumables and tools for various component making processes

pcs.pc_description: determine the quantity and weight of required raw material like rolled sheets, drawn wires of precious metal or alloy etc.,
select the appropriate tools and consumables like files, hammer, ingot mould, sand paper etc.,
prepare the tools, equipment and machines for component making processes
cut the rolled sheet at one end to taper shape
calculate the width of the strip to get the final diameter and thickness of a tube
put the strip in a swage block and bend it approximately in round shape using an appropriate mandrel
bend strip using a thinner and thinner mandrel until the two sides meet
draw the formed or bent strip through a drawplate to get the sides closed
anneal the drawn tube
draw the tube through a smaller hole on drawplate to get the sides closed further
bind the binding wire around the tube to get a proper seam
place soldering chips, flux on the seam
solder, clean the tube and file it to remove any excess solder
solder piece of wire of smaller diameter at one open end of the tube for drawing
prepare clean and filed flat metal sheet of required thickness as mentioned on the job sheet
cut the sheets in the required shape and size using jewellers saw or saw blade
choose the appropriate size of dapping block or cube and punches depending on the size of sheet and kind of metal
set annealed disk into a large dent or depression of dapping block and get hemispherical shape by hammering dapping punches
carry out punching in different dents or successively in smaller dents to achieve the final size or diameter of hemisphere or domes
ensure the proper thickness is maintained during punching stages
inspect the domes for any defects like extra metal or crack
solder two properly filed domes to get a complete ball shape
clean the soldered ball in a pickling bath
file and buff the balls to get final finish
carry out oiling, cleaning of the dapping block, dapping punches regularly
roll a very thin metal sheet of high karat gold and/or silver alloys
scissor narrow fringes along the edge and trim off fringe to get many small squares or platelets of metal
coil thin wire around a thin mandrel and cut into very small jump rings
coat the metal platelets or jump rings with charcoal powder to prevent them from sticking together during firing
place all the coated metal bits in a crucible covered with charcoal powder and fire in a kiln or oven
quench and clean granules using picking bath and water
sort the granules of different sizes manually or using sieves
interpret design which is drawn to 1:1 scale on paper
draw or roll pre-rolled thick wire to smaller required size or gauge
anneal and rinse the wire
straighten the wire using bench vice and hand vice
twist two wires using a hand tool or hand drill
flatten round frame wire or twisted filler wire or textured wire using an anvil and flat planishing hammer or pulling through fixed rolls
shape the frame or inner filler wires on a design using hand, shaping tools like pilers, tweezers and cutting tools like nippers or cold chisels
solder the frame wires to form the outer jacket
fill up the inner filler wires inside the frame wires
solder the whole assembly of frame and filler wires
clean the assembly using an acid bath and water
make jump rings of different sizes by turning a wire around the bottom portion or pavilion of the stone for making prong collet with wire
place a cross wire between the two jump rings and solder them to form prong collet
cut overlapped middle portion of the cross wire and finish using files
bend the cross wire ends to form prongs and solder with jump rings
trim and file extra prong tips before final stone setting
anneal and curve strip around the stone for making bezel collet
cut and solder strip ends to form a small ring-like shape
solder the joined strip to the flat sheet to form bezel collet for cabochon stones
file and taper bezel collet using conning block depending on stone shape before final stone setting
file a measured size of sheet and scribe marks for bending
cut a small square hole along the edge of the sheet for trigger fitment
score the marks bit deeper by sawing and then with a small triangular file
file edges to get beveling before creasing the sheet
bend the sheet at scored marks to form a rectangular box or housing
solder edges and clean the housing
prepare another measured length sheet for making tongue, which would push-fit inside the housing
bend the sheet using planishing hammer and anvil and file edges to get the correct fit inside the housing
solder a sheet and close the housing box keeping one end open for the tongue
prepare measured size of end plate and trigger by sawing and filing etc.,
solder both endplate and trigger to tongue
file the edges of tongue to ensure press or push-fit between tongue and housing
finish all sides of box clasp using smooth sandpaper and files

modules.module_title: Stamping patterns on precious metal sheet

pcs.pc_description: place and secure cut metal sheet or jewellery in fixture or stamping block
choose impression punch with the required pattern
strike the punch on the metal sheet or jewellery with a single blow of hammer and file the stamped components using files
anneal measured length of wire wrapped into a coil
clean the wire using pickling and water
straighten the wire using wood dowelling and a vice
wrap the coil around the wooden dowel or mandrels of the required size for making jump ring coil
anneal, pickle and rinse the jump ring coil
cut off jump rings from the coil using jewellers saw and flatten them using an anvil and flat-faced planishing hammer
interlink jump rings to form a chain and solder ring tips
check the flexibility of chain and attach suitable hook or clasp to the chain
measure the final length
maintain metal loss limit as per company’s loss margin policy
accumulate precious metal dust or fragments dispersed during the process as per standard operating procedure (SOP)
maintain metal loss related documentation
ensure timely delivery of defect-free product or component to the next process and daily or hourly production target is achieved
report to the supervisor about any problems faced or anticipated during the complete process
make sure oiling and cleaning of the roller, draw plate and all tools and equipment and machines used are done at regular intervals as scheduled
check the components before final submission
rework as per the senior’s feedback whenever required, based on inputs from product design and development and production department

modules.module_title: Preparing raw materials, consumables and tools for frame making processes

pcs.pc_description: determine the quantity and weight of required raw material like a sheet, wire of precious metal or alloy etc.,
select appropriate consumables and tools like cutter, files, hammer, sandpaper, position clay, plaster of paris etc.,
prepare the tools, equipment and machines for frame making process

modules.module_title: Prepare the frame and solder the components

pcs.pc_description: roll or draw flat or round wire, strip or sheet for making frame parts
anneal, pickle and rinse all the frame parts
file and polish all the frame parts
bend and shape frame parts using a tweezer or suitable tool to get the design mentioned on the job sheet or design sheet
make accurate outlines or layout of the design on positioning clay
arrange all the outer formed frame parts on the positioning clay
place all the inner components like collet, filigree, granules, link, chain etc., inside frame outline
check symmetry, the flow of the design and place outmost frame metal strip around the assembly
prepare a paste of POP (Plaster of Paris) and water and pour it over the assembly
remove the positioning clay after POP mixture settles down and heat the die using a soldering torch
place soldering balls, chips carefully on the joints and solder the assembly
pickle, rinse and dry the whole assembly
carry out final polishing of the assembly
check the flexibility of the joints
maintain loss limit as per company’s loss margin policy
accumulate precious metal dust or fragments dispersed during the process as per standard operating procedure (SOP)
ensure timely delivery of defect-free product or component to the next process and daily or hourly production target is achieved
report to the supervisor about any problems faced or anticipated during the complete process
make sure oiling and cleaning of all the tools, equipment and machines used are done at regular intervals as scheduled
check the frame and component assembly before final submission
rework as per the senior’s feedback whenever required, based on inputs from product design and development and production department
